B1.detail: Independent Domain counters can issue the same owner and instance IDs; a handle reads the wrong owner across Domains. A single allocator scope works, but that narrower boundary needs review. No claim that new compiler support is necessary.

B2.detail: Source assertions observe handles and registry membership, not destruction of state, closures or event payloads. No supported drop observer was established. No generated Rust instrumentation or invented destructor API.
